run_multiplex_client: run the gRPC multiplex client that makes Greeter and RouteGuide RPCs to localhost:50051
guide_get_feature: call the RouteGuide GetFeature RPC to look up a feature at a given latitude and longitude
guide_list_features: call the RouteGuide ListFeatures RPC to retrieve all features within a rectangular bounding box
guide_record_route: call the RouteGuide RecordRoute RPC to stream random points and receive a route summary
guide_route_chat: call the RouteGuide RouteChat RPC to send and receive bidirectional RouteNote messages
